sar.narrative: Customer C07472, holder of card C07472-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-30 15:47 and 2016-12-04 11:47, 2 transaction(s) totalling $265.85 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $56.19 (3500431, 2016-11-30 15:47), $209.66 (3512563, 2016-12-04 11:47). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.325; Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-3035. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
